title: Concept: Credential compared to a literal (javascript) — review required
description: Comparing a credential to a source literal (api_key === "k9ej2") bakes the secret into every checkout and build. The remedy is loading the expected value from a secret manager.
applicability: javascript authentication checks; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Exposed secrets and unrotatable credentials; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when the literal guards production.
